adrs: .factory/architecture.json ARCH-FRONTEND-BOUNDARIES — pages compose screens, hooks own state, lib owns transport and pure helpers, components own UI behavior; a Markdown citation formatter belongs in lib and is tested as a pure function.

.factory/architecture.json ARCH-DEEP-MODULES — reuse existing seams before adding parallel helpers, one-off abstractions, or speculative extension points; the fix extends formatCitation in place rather than introducing a second formatter.
.factory/architecture.json DEBT-CHAT-AREA — ChatArea.tsx is a no-growth zone; any temptation to repair the marker/snippet at the call site must be refused in favor of the lib seam.

Issue #147 decision (recorded in the exportMarkdown.ts:26-28 comment and api.ts Citation docstrings) — Dynamous citations link to the Circle lesson_url because Circle lacks timestamp deep-links; this introduced the dynamous branch and its marker-less empty-lesson_url fallback that AC-3 repairs.
callers: formatSources → formatCitation (exportMarkdown.ts:63 via sources.map(formatCitation)) — the only in-module caller; its join('\n') makes the '- ' marker semantically load-bearing.
exportConversationAsMarkdown → formatSources (exportMarkdown.ts:74) — renders the per-message Sources section of the exported document.

ChatArea.handleExport → exportConversationAsMarkdown (app/frontend/src/components/ChatArea.tsx:613-623, Export button at 650-696) — the sole UI trigger; wraps the call in try/catch with an error toast. Not modified by this change (DEBT-CHAT-AREA no-growth; issue out-of-scope).
app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.test.ts — direct caller of all four exports; the assertion surface where the AC-1..AC-3 tests are added.
history: Issue #147 — added source_type/lesson_url to Citation and the dynamous branch to formatCitation, establishing the '- [title](url) — <range>\n  > "<snippet>"' success shape; the empty-lesson_url fallback has existed in its current marker-less form since that change.
Issue #208 — added Citation.segment_count (server-side segment collapse, api.ts:74-78); part of the Citation type's evolution; no export-formatting impact.

Two-tier is_cited Sources rendering (api.ts:54-60 docstring) — implemented for the chat UI's citation rendering but absent from exportMarkdown's Sources section; flagged during investigation as a nearby oddity and explicitly out of scope here (would need its own issue).

Issue #49 (this run) — reported that markdown export silently drops the transcript snippet when a citation URL cannot be parsed and omits the '- ' marker on the two YouTube fallbacks and the Dynamous empty-lesson_url path; acceptance criteria AC-1..AC-3 pin the repair.
invariants: Every exported citation entry that survives the non-empty-snippet guard keeps its transcript snippet as a '> "snippet"' blockquote — MISSION.md 'RAG responses with rich citations' requires every cited chunk to show its snippet, and the export must not silently drop it.

Every emitted citation entry begins with '- ' so formatSources' newline-joined output renders as one Markdown list item per citation; a marker-less fallback must not merge into the previous list item.

The fix is additive on the three degraded returns: the '(timestamp link unavailable)' wording, the '— <range>' tail, the exact console.warn payloads in both YouTube fallback branches, and the no-link guarantee (no '](' on the Dynamous empty-lesson_url path) are preserved — every current case in app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.test.ts keeps passing unchanged.

Both YouTube fallback branches (new URL() throwing, and video_url yielding no v parameter) receive the same '- ' marker + snippet blockquote treatment; repairing only the catch branch would leave the described bug half-fixed (the missing-v branch is enforced by this invariant plus the existing 'no v param' test continuing to pass).
Only production file changed: app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.ts. Acceptance tests are added inside the existing app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.test.ts (no new test file).
frontend-lib may import nothing (.factory/architecture.json: frontend-lib allowed_imports: []); the fix stays a pure function with no new imports, no state, no I/O, and no new dependency edges.
symbols: formatCitation (app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.ts:21-59) — the seam under repair; a pure citation-to-Markdown-list-entry function. Branch chain: blank-snippet guard returns '' (nearby oddity, out of scope); range = 'formatTimestamp(start)–formatTimestamp(end)'; dynamous branch where an empty lesson_url returns '<title> — <range>\n  > "<snippet>"' with no '- ' marker (line 32); YouTube branch where new URL() throwing (line 46) or a missing v param (line 53) returns '<title> (timestamp link unavailable) — <range>' with neither marker nor blockquote; success paths (lines 35, 58) show the target shape '- [title](url) — <range>\n  > "<snippet>"'.

exportConversationAsMarkdown (app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.ts:66-86) — export entry point: header, per-message bodies with formatSources(msg.sources), slug filename, saveAs(file-saver). Must not change.

Citation interface (app/frontend/src/lib/api.ts:46-79) — formatCitation's input contract: required snippet; optional source_type ('youtube' | 'dynamous' | string), lesson_url, is_cited, segment_count. Loose string unions mean branch logic must not assume the literal values.

console.warn payloads '[exportMarkdown] Skipping timestamp link — invalid video_url: "<video_url>"' (app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.ts:43-45 and 50-52) — byte-pinned by the existing invalid-URL test; the contract requires leaving these calls untouched.
tests: app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.test.ts describe('formatCitation') — holds every pinned current behavior that must keep passing unchanged: invalid-URL fallback with exact console.warn payload (lines 215-227), no-v-param fallback (229-235), empty video_title (237-241), Dynamous lesson_url link (243-258), Dynamous empty-lesson_url no-link fallback (260-272). New AC-1/AC-2 cases use { ...baseCitation, video_url: 'not-a-url', snippet: 'Relevant text' }; the AC-3 starts-with assertion extends or siblings the existing Dynamous empty-lesson_url case (lines 260-272).

app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.test.ts describe('formatSources') (lines 275-310) — pins that success entries render as '- [Test Video]' list items and that multiple citations are newline-joined; guards the list-item semantics the fix restores for degraded entries.

Repro command, deferred-to-red per contract risk: 'cd app/frontend && bun run test src/lib/exportMarkdown.test.ts' — predicted green on the unchanged tree until the AC-1..AC-3 assertions are added; if unexpectedly red before any change, escalate rather than proceed.

Frontend gates: 'bun run tsc --noEmit', 'bun x biome check src', 'bun run test' (plus the factory's harness/unit.py canonical unit gate) must all stay green — the change is type-free and pure, so risk is confined to the vitest assertions.
